lead: Céline Dion is best known as a Canadian singer, born on 30 March 1968 in Charlemagne.
As of 2026, she is 58 years old, and her birth date places her under the Aries sign.
She has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Knight of the Legion of Honour and Chevalier des Arts et des Lettres.

sections.heading: Céline Dion — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Céline Dion was born on 30 March 1968 in Charlemagne, and holds Canadian nationality. She was given the name Céline Marie Claudette Dion at birth and is publicly known as Céline Dion.
Public records name her father, Adhémar Dion and her mother, Thérèse Dion. She is a sibling of Claudette Dion, Paul Dion and Jacques Dion.
She is recorded as speaking English and French.

sections.heading: Céline Dion — Career and Professional Work
paras: Céline Dion works primarily as a singer and composer.
She has taken part in Eurovision Song Contest 1988.
